en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a dense historic town with tiled roofs and narrow streets, opening onto a broad square in the foreground. Dominating the square is a large, somewhat worn-looking town hall building with many rectangular windows and a central entrance, attached to a tall clock tower with a baroque-style roof and spire. In front of it stands a row of multi‑storey bourgeois houses bearing shop signs. Further back appear church towers and a round defensive tower, with open countryside and industrial facilities visible on the horizon.
